data.name: Rabeeun
data.gender_notes: Rabeeun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is content and satisfied with what Allah has given him. The name Rabeeun carries the meaning “Content, Satisfied” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rabeeun usually hope their child will grow to embody content, satisfied and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Rabeeun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Content, Satisfied.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rabeeun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Rabeeun
in_english.meaning: First of the four winter months in the Islamic calendar
in_english.long_meaning: The first of the four winter months in the Islamic calendar, which starts in Rajab and ends in Ramadan. It is a time of renewal and growth, when plants and flowers bloom. This month is considered the best time for fasting and worship in Islam, according to the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad. It is also a significant month in Islamic history, as it marks the beginning of the Islamic calendar and the start of the Hajj season. In Arabic, the root of the name is 'rab'a', which means to increase or multiply, reflecting the growth and abundance of this season
